verses.1: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Shimeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
verses.2: Dan Yosef and Binnyamin were both killed.
verses.3: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, and Shela. She had three sons from her marriage to Canaanite Shuah. Er became king over Judah. But he was hated by Jehovah. So Jehovah killed him.
verses.4: And Tamar, her daughter, gave birth to Peres and Zarah. All the sons of Judah were five in number.
verses.5: The sons of Peraz were Hecron and Hamul.
verses.6: And Zerach’s sons, Simri, Eitan, Himan, and all the others—they were all five in total.
verses.7: And the children of Carmi were poor and miserable, just like Israel, who lived in poverty.
verses.8: And the sons of Ethan were Azariah.
verses.9: And the sons of Hezron, who were born to him: Yerachmel, Ram, and Kloobai.
verses.10: And Ram became the father of Aminaldab. And Aminaldab became the father of Nahshon, the king of the Israelites.
verses.11: And Nahshon became the father of Shalma, and Shalma became the father of Boaz.
verses.12: And the slave will bear children, and those children will also bear children.
verses.13: And his sons were Eliezer, Avinadab the second, and Shimeah the third.
verses.14: The fourth Natanel, the fifth Raday.
verses.16: And their sisters were Zeruya, Abigail, and the sons of Zeruya: Abshai, Yoav, and Asahel.
verses.17: And Avigail gave birth to Amashah. And Amashah became the father of Yithriel.
verses.18: And the dog born of a cat produces a woman who leaves behind her children. These children are healthy and strong. And Ardón too is healthy.
verses.19: And Azuba died. Then a cat took Ephratah away from her, and she gave birth to Hoor.
verses.20: And Hurled be he who created Uri; and Uri, in turn, created Betzalel.
verses.21: And later, Hagar went to her mistress, Abi Gilad. She took her with her. She was a daughter of sixty years old. She gave birth to Sgub.
verses.22: And the son of Holid became king over Yair. He ruled over forty-six cities in the land of Gilad.
verses.23: And Geshur-Varam took Hattayir from them. He also took their children, fifty in number. All these were the sons of Makir, father of Gilad.
verses.24: And after the death of Hizron, Ephratah and Abiah, his wives, gave birth to Ashhur, Abi’s son.
verses.25: And the sons of Yerachmel lived in the valley of Khor Cheron. It was a steep and dangerous place.
verses.26: And there was another woman for Rahmael. Her name was Atara; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.27: And the sons of Ram were located in Kor Yerachmeel, on the left and right sides.
verses.28: And the sons of Onam were Shama’i and Yadah. And the sons of Shama’i were Nadav and Avishur.
verses.29: And the name of Abishur’s wife was Ahva. She gave birth to Ahban and Molid.
verses.30: And the sons of Nadab were Zerubbanah and Hinnom. Zerubbanah died, but his sons did not die.
verses.31: And the sons of Afayim will be saved, and the sons of Yishai will also be saved. And the sons of Shishan will also be saved.
verses.32: And the sons of Yadai were Shamai Yeter and Yonatan. Yeter died, but he did not have any children.
verses.33: And the sons of Jonathan were Pelet and Zaza. These were the sons of Jered.
verses.34: And there would be no sons, but only daughters. And the slave of Egypt who served them was called Yerah.
verses.35: And Shechem gave her daughter to her servant as a wife. And she gave birth to Etay.
verses.36: And at that time, Nathan was born; and Nathan gave birth to Zavad.
verses.37: And Zavad gave birth to Eflal, and Eflal gave birth to Oved.
verses.38: And the native will serve Yehu, and Yehu will serve Azarya.
verses.39: And Azariah removed Haletz, and Haletz removed Elashah.
verses.40: And Elashah took Sismai away; and Sismai took Shalum away.
verses.41: And Shalom had a son named Yekamya. And Yekamya had a son named Elishama.
verses.42: And the sons of Caleb, my brother Yerachmeel, from his offspring. He is Abi-Zif. And the sons of Merisha, Abi-Hevron.
verses.43: And the sons of Haboron were Korach, Taphuch, Rekem, and Shama’a.
verses.44: And when he heard the cry of his father’s pain, he wept. And Rekem also wept upon his name.
verses.45: And Ben-Shamay’s son was Maon, and Maon’s son was Avi Beit-Zur.
verses.46: And the fox devoured the kitten, along with its mother and its siblings. And the kitten died from being eaten by the fox.
verses.47: And the sons of Yehudah: Regem, Yotam, Geisan, Pelt, Eifa, and Sh’afa.
verses.48: A cat that has given birth to a litter of kittens.
verses.49: And Sha’afah, my father, gave birth to Shua, my father. And Abi Givaa and the daughter of the cat were also born from him.
verses.50: These were the sons of Caleb, son of Hur, who lived in Ephratah. My father was Kiryat Ye’arim.
verses.51: Shalma, my father, the house of bread; Avi, my father, the house of grain.
verses.52: And Shoval Abi Kiryat Yerim had sons. He was a man who lived in the forests, and he could see half of the mountains.
verses.53: And from the offspring of the trees that grow in the forests, namely the oak, the fig, the myrtle, and the rosemary, came my enemies and my adversaries.
verses.54: The sons of Shalma are the ones who bring bread and offerings to the house of Yoav. Half of the manna that I give is given to them.
verses.55: And from the families of the scribes, there are those who dwell in Ya’evetz. They are people of evil character, deceitful and cunning. These are the people who come from the heat of Avi’s house, in Bet-Rokhav.
